Taylor (People Ops): Quick coordination thread for Priya's first day (next Wed). She mentioned her passport renewal is in progress but she has a Permanent Resident Card + state ID. Can we confirm I-9 acceptance and a badge/laptop pickup window?

Priya Kaur: Hi! Yes PR card + CA ID. I can be there any time between 8:30-10am. Also, is there a short benefits intro on day 1?

Ravi Menon: PR card is valid as List A. Must present the physical card. State ID covers List B if needed but don't mix if you're using List A.

Taylor (People Ops): Thanks Ravi. Liam, can Facilities do a badge photo slot at 9am and badge desk + laptop handoff?

Liam - Facilities: Yes 9:00 @ Main Lobby works. I'll reserve kiosk 2. I'll also have someone I-9-qualified on-site at 9:00-9:30.

OnboardingBot: provisioning queued: priya.kaur@redwood.com  device: rdw-slate-14 v3, enrollment pending.

Priya Kaur: Perfect, 9am is good. About benefits: I saw a 3pm orientation invite in calendar - is that correct?

Taylor (People Ops): Correct  3:00-4:00 in Conf Gamma. We'll send welcome packet + benefits links after you check in.

Priya Kaur: One more thing  I have a handwriting discrepancy on my SSN card name (maiden vs current). Will that block I-9?

Ravi Menon: Usually not a blocker. Verifier uses combination of docs + attestation. If the SS card differs, bring a secondary doc (birth cert or court name change). If still unclear, we can use the exception remote-verification flow.

Taylor (People Ops): Remote exception flow summary:

```
- Candidate records a short ID verification video showing original docs (front/back)
- Manager sends an attestation email to people-ops@redwood.com cc verifier
- On-site verifier completes a follow-up within 3 business days to inspect originals
```

Priya Kaur: Good to know. Hopefully not needed. Background check already submitted.

ClearCheckBot: Background check complete for Priya Kaur (cid: 9182)  RESULT: Clear, no sanctions.

Liam - Facilities: Escort confirmed. I'll meet Priya at Main Lobby at 8:55, take photo at kiosk 2, then to IT desk for laptop.

Ravi Menon: If anyone's doing the remote exception, note we need manager attestation in the form: "I, <manager name>, confirm I have met/know the identity of <new hire name> and attest the documents shown are genuine." Simple email is fine.

Taylor (People Ops): Adding everything to the calendar now: 9:00 check-in (Main Lobby) -> badge + I-9, 3:00 benefits (Conf Gamma). Priya, we'll also send a checklist with what to bring.

Priya Kaur: Thank you! See you Wednesday :smile: 

OnboardingBot: laptop imaging started. MDM invite will follow provisioning.
